newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Baron de Ley's IPO price at 2,350 pta/share.
newsitem.headline: Spain Baron de Ley's IPO price at 2,350 pta/share.

text.p: Spanish winery Baron de Ley said on Monday that shares in its public offering have been priced at 2,350 pesetas for the domestic and international institutional investor tranches.
In a statement, Baron de Ley added that the final price has been fixed 100 pesetas above the non-mandatory maximum price initially reported.
Final allocation is of 1.9 million shares for the domestic tranche and 2.9 million shares for the international one.
Baron de Ley added total demand was 25 times the offer.
Shares of Baron de Ley will start to be screen traded from Wednesday.
